description: Model, simulate, and optimize Serializer/Deserializer (SerDes) systems — serial and parallel links — using MATLAB SerDes Toolbox. Design NRZ and PAM-N links (PAM3 through PAM16) — explore equalization architectures (FFE, CTLE, DFE), sweep or optimize parameters with genetic algorithms, and characterize channels from loss models, S-parameter files, or crosstalk scenarios. Process captured waveforms through equalization chains, build eye diagrams, and decompose jitter. Deliver IBIS-AMI models for Tx, Rx, Redriver, or Retimer by exporting to Simulink and compiling .ami/.ibs/.dll/.so files. Covers the full arc from initial design exploration and parameter optimization to compliance testing and compiled model validation, including custom datapath blocks for nonstandard equalization.
